Mirabell Bell is a soldier and a reoccurring character of the online games, and playable in Action Taimanin.

Squad leader in one of the UFS Army's Special Mechanized Unit, the Stormcat. She is a pilot of a XPS-11A Bone and later Claudius.

Akiyama Rinko, Mizuki Yukikaze, and Shishimura Koro, how are you all? I wanted to thank you for all your help during the training last time.
Mirabell Bell



Personality
Mirabell is a hardened and serious Soldier, known to fight very tactical and being a great commander, which is loved by her Stormcat group. Mirabell is polite and self controlled towards those above and below her, and remains calm in combat.

She has a high sense of justice but will follow her duty if forced to some degree, but her patriotism is not fundamentalist, and she would never harm the innocent even if ordered. Since her early days, had been entrusted to the words of her former mentor to protect those without weapons and power, as soldiers like them would otherwise not be soldiers on the side of justice and instead be nothing but killers. She is especially strategic in combat, and experienced, typically used to being outgunned. She enjoys the XPS-11A Bone power suits, and even feels some form of nostalgia towards them, even if they are sooner or later outclassed and she is aware of that.

Known to deeply care for her team, she will sacrifice herself for them if needed, her team in turn, trusts, respects and loves her like family. Having mostly a stern and unshaken look, which can be intimidating, she can be shy about sexual matters and inexperienced. She also suffers from some sort of childhood trauma regarding her father, which sometimes results in nightmares but has not disclosed. Has a difficult past to her former mentor and idol, Maria Bright, and feels deep worry, that she could end like her if she was overwhelmed by the corruption within the UFS. Deeply dislikes David Dahl, for the same corruption.

Overall respectful towards the Taimanin and Japan, unlike some people in the UFS. Attempts to try out some Japanese things, like traditional clothes, food, drinks, festivals, especially when on vacation and is curious, attemping to sometimes immitate something she saw as typically Japanse but becomes embarrased if it isn't her style.


Appearance
A woman with long black hair, brown skin and yellow eyes. She also has a large bust and thick eyebrows.

History
Background
Pilot of the XPS-11A Bone. She is an excellent non-commissioned officer who has served with distinction in the UFS Army's raids on Chinese Union facilities.

She has solid tactical command and is an expert in close-quarters fire fighting with her reinforced exoskeleton. Furthermore, she has been active in the U.S.led war against terrorism in the Middle East, serving as a "liaison" to the military advisors. Mirabell's mentor, which gave her most of her values to protect the helpless, was Maria Bright that at the time was a lieutenant. However, in a combat zone, Maria suddenly would sell out her unit and Mirabell's colleges were killed, Mirabell survived though was gravely injured. Afterward, she informed the higher ups of the betrayal, but Maria had at that point already escaped and became a terrorist known as McKnight.

When the conflict in Amidahara intensifies, the unit came to Japan to protect the UFS's interests in the medical technology of the demon world. She becomes the first captain of the newly established "Stormcat", a reinforced exoskeleton unit for female soldiers only.

Timeline TABA
She appears in some events, mostly as part of the UFS, while getting into conflict with members of the Fuuma Organization. Mirabell is not part of DSO or Task Force G but often is called in to fight or defend locations of the UFS regardless.

Timeline RPGX
In chapter 40, Fuuma Kotaro took care of a gang of slave traders. With the help of the Nakanoshima Gangsters and the Fire Taimanin, Saionji Ento. Right afterward Kotaro is arrested by Mirabell under orders of the UFS. To avoid conflict between Japan and the UFS, he goes along willingly. Appears in other events as well, playing a minor role.

Mirabell takes part in a test battle against the Claudius unit. A Exoskeleton, created by Task Force G and David Dahl, which fights her XPS-11A Bone unit Stormcat. After, the Bones are defeated by the new Claudius, Mirabell voices that the age of the Bone is coming to an end. In her interaction with David Dahl, she is polite but dislikes the man.

In year 2087, Mirabell asked for a presentation of Taimanin abilities and the "Itto Style". Akiyama Rinko, Mizuki Yukikaze and Shishimura Koro arrived and took part in a mock battle in Fort Clark. Mirabell's soldiers befriended the Taimanin after their fight, even though they were defeated.

At this point, Mirabell was given one of the Claudius units, and on a special mission of the UFS military was sent out to deal with a criminal group of Tokyo Kingdom, which had worked with Task Force G. However, this was a trap of David Dahl and Kanda, Mirabell was attacked by the Kanda Brigade, with Ares observing the situation. As Ares, noted, Kanda possibly planned to betray David Dahl, to be taking the Claudius technology for himself, regardless of their partnership. Mirabell was able, to sent their soldiers to safety but was hunted down by PEX-88 Type Raiden and PEX-00 Type Shusui units. Jumping into an ongoing race of the Tokyo Kingdom Circuit, she was able to secure help from Taimanin, Club Persona and Nomad. Afterward, Mirabell paid for the damages on the track, threw a small party with food.

In year 2088, she became a lieutenant, and was sent out to eliminate Maria (terrorist McKnight), which was spotted in Yomihara. Assisted by Alecky, the small unit had no support of the Taimanin because of the tension between Taimanin and Nomad after the destruction of the Demon Gate in Yomihara. As Mirabell entered the city, she was confronted by Shinganji Kurenai which assisted Nomad, in an attempt to calm the situation as Nomad also currently was leaderless without Edwin Black (RPGX). Mirabell agreed to a deal with Kurenai to quickly deal with the terrorist, but not to damage the city or fight Nomad. The group reached the mushroom forest areas, and Mirabell finally confronted Maria. Using her Claudius, she struggled against the Demonization version of Maria and her own Exoskeleton. She asked again why she had betrayed the UFS, and Maria explained that though she thought she fought for justice in the end, she was forced to kill children and civilians, continuing to do so in the hope of a greater just purpose, but it was all a lie and corruption of people like David Dahl, so he could climb rank and obtain status. Maria, had become disillusioned with the power of the higher ups and their corruption, and now hoped to use the chaos of Yomihara to gain independent power. As, Kurenai, saved Alecky from a FSD Crius, Mirabell and Maria continued to fight. As Mirabell's Claudius exploded, she jumped out of it and plunged her combat knife deeply into the vital organs of her former mentor, which died on the spot. Mirabell gave the order to retreat, but while nobody was looking, she fell shortly to the mud, and looked at her former superior lieutenant, worried that she would end the same way if the corruption would overwhelm her.

She was assigned command of a small diplomatic mission during the new year of the year of the snake in Gosha Village. Laetitia Bellmer and Faleila working under her made afterward a short visit to Mikuruma Shrine.

Timeline Action
Mentioned in the XPS-11A Bone description entry, as the "captain" by Kuonji R. Spica.

Mirabell Bell and her Stormcats were sent to Kinki International Airport as part of a joint training mission between UFS and Japan, aimed at strengthening their alliance. Arriving one month ahead of schedule, they were greeted by Kuonji R. Spica, with some time reserved for vacation. However, their visit quickly took a turn for the worse. As the group prepared to leave the airport, it became the target of a random terror attack. Mirabell and her team sprang into action, assisting in saving the civilians involved while trying to avoid drawing too much attention as outsiders. Despite their efforts, the situation escalated, forcing them to move on. Spica then led the group to a hotel in Amidahara for the night. Unfortunately, the next morning, before they could even eat, the group found themselves in conflict with a mafia faction linked to the Chinese Union. The situation quickly became dire, and Mirabell’s team was forced to flee, leaving behind massive damage to the criminal group in their wake. In their escape, they destroyed several vehicles of the mafia, which only heightened the danger.

Their journey continued to Maesaki City, with the ultimate goal of reaching Gosha Village. Along the way, a stray bullet struck one of their vehicles, forcing the group to search for fuel. However, they once again encountered another group of thugs connected to the same mafia from Amidahara. A fierce battle ensued, but this smaller group was also defeated. Despite this victory, Mirabell and Spica’s vehicles were set on fire, and they were forced to walk the rest of the way to Maesaki City. By the time they arrived, it was deep into the night, and Hasuba Reiko had been waiting for them, initially assuming their delay was due to undisciplined behavior. However, when she saw the exhausted but still composed group, Mirabell apologized and explained the chaos they had faced. With several cars destroyed along the way and the team utterly drained, they finally settled in for a well-needed rest, their resilience clear despite the tumultuous journey.


Powers/Abilities
Mirabell Ultimate
Main Weapon: Firearm

XPS-11A Bone: Exoskeleton power suit.
Claudius: Exoskeleton power suit. (Later parts of RPGX)
Tools: Smoke bombs, multiple fire arms.
Knife Combat: Able to fight in close combat with a knife, to a high level.

Trivia
Her physical strength comes simply from training.
Written as Mirabel Bel in Taimanin RPGX.
The exact name of her group appears to vary based on her assignment, unlike DSO or G members, as she has worked typically for the military arm or intelligence agency of the UFS.
